title: Finite support for an extended computation
statement: For any word width $W$, extended program $P$, input bit strings $x$ and $\rho$, natural number $n$, and extended configurations $c,c'$, if $c'$ is reached from $c$ in $n$ extended steps, then there is a finite set $K$ of integer addresses with $|K|\le 3n$ such that the same computation takes $n$ steps with every instruction's touched addresses contained in $K$.
hypotheses_covered: An extended computation of length $n$ from $c$ to $c'$
